trickyParts: A merged PR's closed event has github.ref = refs/heads/main, so every pull_request concurrency key is the PR number; docs keeps github.ref for push so a closed run never cancels main's Pages build.
A job skipped by its own if: enters no job-level group, so Worker Image's group moved to workflow level and the job-level block was deleted (a same-named job group would wait on itself).
The Tests canceller's job-level group cancels the workflow-level Tests run of another workflow when the job enters the group, before it gets a runner (P4).
A running docker build stops slowly: the closed run cancelled the running Worker Image build after 97 s (P4b).
deviations: Plan D1 replaced by the architect's option (b): tests-closed.yaml (job cancel-tests) joins tests-<number>; Tests' key moved to the PR number.
The simplify pass ran before the scratch proofs, so every proof ran at the final code head 4773bb61.

P5's first caller run (40451991938) had its attest cancelled and re-run by another session acting as legion-implementer[bot]; its re-run attempt was cancelled by this implementer to stop a duplicate image build. Both builds had already ended success.
openQuestions: cancel-tests needs a runner per close; a skipped job under a workflow-level group would need none. Kept job-level as the architect decided.
